title: Responsible AI in criminal justice: LLMs in policing and risks to case progression

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual risk assessment identifying how LLMs might alter pronouns in generated witness statements based on professions, or change emphasis in summaries depending on the subject's gender.
Conceptual risk assessment evaluating how LLM-assisted risk assessment forms might skew scores or emphasis against ethnic minority offenders based on embedded training data biases.
Conceptual risk assessment identifying the potential for LLMs to mistranslate or misinterpret local dialects, colloquialisms, and speech from individuals who use English as a second language.
Conceptual risk assessment evaluating the risk of LLMs failing to accurately and completely represent statements from neurodiverse individuals or those with mental health and learning difficulties.
